ins.t: 2026: the best guide to what a defense allows next week was adjusted (opponent-adjusted, recent games count more) — rank correlation +.07, best in 2 of 5 weeks; the weakest was 2024 (+.02). Touchdowns are the noisiest: the best data set for TDs (adjusted) reached only +.06.

2025: the best guide to what a defense allows next week was adjusted (opponent-adjusted, recent games count more) — rank correlation +.05, best in 5 of 17 weeks; the weakest was 2024 (+.04). Touchdowns are the noisiest: the best data set for TDs (adjusted) reached only +.03.
2026, picking touchdowns: Anytime-TD model ranked scorers best (AUC 0.598; .500 = coin flip), then His recent PPR (0.596). TD allowed to his slot: 0.529 · Ψ: 0.534 · META: 0.539 · H2H: 0.492.

2026, the matchup itself (did a player beat his own average?): Implied team total was the best read (ρ +.11); soft third vs tough third by Ψ: +.82 PPR, by TD allowed: +.65, by SCH: +.78, by H2H: +.36.
2025, picking touchdowns: Anytime-TD model ranked scorers best (AUC 0.600; .500 = coin flip), then His recent PPR (0.593). TD allowed to his slot: 0.512 · Ψ: 0.509 · META: 0.537 · H2H: 0.472.
2025, the matchup itself (did a player beat his own average?): SCH was the best read (ρ +.08); soft third vs tough third by Ψ: +.66 PPR, by TD allowed: +.58, by SCH: +1.32, by H2H: −.12.

2026: read through the adjusted table instead of the combined blend (the site's default), the matchup signals got better at calling who beat his own average in 4 of 4 cases — Ψ +.09 vs +.03, TD allowed +.10 vs +.03.
2026: META beat its own parts at picking scorers (AUC 0.539 vs Ψ 0.534, TD allowed 0.529) — most of its edge comes from the anytime-TD model folded inside it (0.598 on its own).
2026: H2H (how he did against this opponent before) carried no signal — AUC 0.492, below a coin flip, and ρ −.03 against his norm; only 49% of players had a prior meeting.
